description:
Incredibly light yet reassuringly precise, Asola rips up the rulebook to get you to the summit and back in record time.

Experience the sublime handling of a masterfully built carbon fibre frame designed for absurd speed and limitless control - a fluid, kinetic chassis connected to the road through decades of advanced composite development and handmade craftsmanship.

Asola’s slim silhouette boasts elegantly shaped 50mm tubes sculpted with selective reinforcements and a maximum thickness of 0.7mm. Throughout the frame, medium and high modulus fibres deployed with over twenty years of composite experience translate to a stiff, responsive ride that stays smooth even over rough roads.

Our best-selling frame, taken to new heights with powerful disc brakes and clean cable integration.

Impossibly fine 0.09mm 1k fibre outer skin optimises the adhesion of the wrapping to complete Asola’s exquisite looks.

Asola Plus is available with two control options: an ultralight aluminium handlebar with traditional sections, which fits perfectly with the round tube design of the frame, or an aero carbon handlebar designed for optimal cable integration. Asola’s fork features d-shape steerer technology and accommodates up to 30mm tires.
